title: Pinned-base portal frame with a load at midspan of the beam

source.work: Bentley Systems, STAAD.Pro Help, Verification Examples (public documentation, docs.bentley.com)
source.edition: STAAD.Pro Help v21 build (pages refer to the STAAD.Pro 2023 sample files), read 2026-11-22
source.notes: problem statement taken from the vendor page (text and input listing). The page cites: Timoshenko, Strength of Materials, Part I, 2nd ed. 1940, pp. 188-191 - NOT opened for this project; no number is taken from it. The page's 'theory' values are recorded as printed; the program's own results are not used.

analysis: Plane problem in the global X-Y plane (Y vertical); the out-of-plane DOFs (uz, rx, ry) of every node are held; in-plane bending about local z. Portal: columns 100 in high, 2 in x 2 in (A = 4 in^2, I = 1.3333 in^4), beam of 120 in, 2 in wide and 4 in deep (A = 8 in^2, I = 10.667 in^4), E = 30e6 psi, pinned bases; 1000 lb at midspan (taken downward; the page's listing applies it upward, its results are magnitudes). First-order analysis with axial deformation, without shear deformation. Reference values: computed here from this statement (verification/derive/vendor_reference.py); the textbook cited by the vendor page was not opened and no number is taken from it.
